name: Palk Strait
genZNote: Palk Strait is the one on this list you could almost swim across on a map — India and Sri Lanka are that close here, connected by shallow water and a shared fishing dispute.

sections.heading: 🚨 Location & What It Connects
bullets: A shallow strait between Tamil Nadu (India) and northern Sri Lanka.
Connects the Bay of Bengal to the Gulf of Mannar (and onward to the Arabian Sea/Indian Ocean), lying between mainland India and Sri Lanka.
Too shallow for large ocean-going vessels — it's a small-craft and fishing route, not a major cargo shipping lane.

sections.heading: ⚓ Why It Matters
bullets: Best known for the Adam's Bridge (Rama's Bridge) chain of shoals between India and Sri Lanka, and for cross-border fishing activity by fishermen from both countries.
A recurring subject of India-Sri Lanka discussions around fishing rights, given how narrow and shared the waters are.
Unlike every other chokepoint in this section, it matters for regional/local reasons rather than global shipping volume.

sections.heading: 🇮🇳 India Connection
bullets: Directly between India (Tamil Nadu) and Sri Lanka — one of India's closest maritime neighbor relationships, geographically speaking.
Relevant to India's coastal fishing communities in Tamil Nadu and to India-Sri Lanka bilateral maritime discussions.

quickRevision.oneLineDefinition: The Palk Strait is a shallow strait between Tamil Nadu, India, and northern Sri Lanka, important for regional fishing rather than global shipping.
keyFacts: Between Tamil Nadu (India) and northern Sri Lanka.
Connects the Bay of Bengal to the Gulf of Mannar.
Too shallow for large ocean-going vessels.
Site of the Adam's Bridge (Rama's Bridge) shoal chain.
commonConfusion: Don't lump the Palk Strait in with global chokepoints like Hormuz or Malacca by trade volume — its significance is regional, not global.

highYieldFacts: Palk Strait: between Tamil Nadu and Sri Lanka.
Connects Bay of Bengal to the Gulf of Mannar.
Adam's Bridge (Rama's Bridge) lies within it.
commonTraps: A shallow strait can still be exam-relevant for reasons other than shipping volume — here it's fishing rights and bilateral relations.
mustRemember: Palk Strait = India-Sri Lanka's shared, shallow strait; Adam's Bridge; fishing-rights significance.
